blocks.title: Avogadro constant
blocks.text: Avogadro constant, L, 1 mole mein muqarrar zarraat (atoms, molecules ya ions) ki tadaad hai.

Electrolytic tareeqa 1 mole electrons se juray charge ka hisab laga kar Avogadro constant ki qeemat de sakta hai: L = (1 mole electrons par charge) / (1 electron par charge). Electron ka charge tajurbe se taqreeban 1.60 x 10^-19 C milta hai. Agle do topics batate hain ke ek mole electrons ka charge kaise milta hai aur hisab kaise hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek mole electrons ke charge ko ek electron ke charge par taqseem karna Avogadro's constant kyun deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Ek mole electrons mein L electrons hote hain, har ek ka charge 1.60 x 10^-19 C, to kul charge L zarb electron ka charge hai. Fi mole kul charge electrolysis se naap kar aur maloom fi electron charge par taqseem kar ke ek mole ke electrons gine jate hain, jo L hai.

items: L = fi mole zarraat = (1 mol electrons par charge) / (1 electron par charge, 1.60 x 10^-19 C); pehla electrolysis se milta hai.
